propositions: Cloud probe hardcodes RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES to frozenset({'Resolved','Done','Cancelled'}) with no runtime configuration option, while DC reconciler reads resolved_statuses from config, creating parity gap.
Cloud tenants using non-standard workflow status names (e.g. 'Closed', 'Complete', "Won't Do") have issues misclassified as PRESENT_FILTERED instead of PRESENT_RESOLVED.
JiraConfig must expose resolved_statuses as a configurable list[str] field with environment override REBAR_JIRA_RESOLVED_STATUSES, defaulting to the current hardcoded three names.
The probe's classify_probe_response must resolve the configured status set at runtime via a coercer-driven hook, falling back to module-level default when unset, empty, or malformed ConfigError.

Custom tenant configuration (e.g. jira.resolved_statuses = ["Closed","Complete"]) must properly classify matching statuses as PRESENT_RESOLVED and exclude non-matching statuses from that classification.
Explicitly empty configured list must fall back to module default rather than bind an empty set, maintaining backward compatibility for stock tenants.
